title: Muru workshops
description: Guided JupyterLab workshops on Muru, the routing edge, control plane and Python runtime for WSGI and ASGI applications.

collections.title: Meet Muru
collections.description: Guided JupyterLab workshops introducing Muru: where it fits among Python web servers, what it does while you develop, and how its daemon deploys releases without downtime, compared throughout with Apache and mod_wsgi, gunicorn, uvicorn and Granian.
